candidates.label: parentTaxon
candidates.comment: A taxonomic relation between a taxon and its immediate higher-level taxon. Also called is a sub-taxon of, belongs to the taxon, is classified under. Examples: Homo is a parent taxon of Homo sapiens. Felidae is a parent taxon of Panthera. Mammalia is a parent taxon of Primates.

candidates.label: causeOf
candidates.comment: A causal relation between a medical cause and the medical entity (condition, complication, symptom) it produces. Also called "results in", "leads to", "produces". Examples: "Influenza virus medical causeOf Flu", "Smoking medical causeOf Lung cancer". Distinct from cause, which describes what leads to a condition, whereas causeOf describes what a medical cause leads to.

candidates.label: connectedTo
candidates.comment: A connection relation between an anatomical structure and other anatomical structures it is connected to. Also called "linked to", "adjoins", "connects with". Examples: "Femur anatomical structure connectedTo Tibia", "Brain anatomical structure connectedTo Spinal cord".

candidates.label: about

candidates.label: taxonomicRange

candidates.label: event

candidates.label: subEvents

candidates.label: afterMedia

candidates.label: observationPeriod

candidates.label: subjectOf

candidates.label: eventAttendanceMode
candidates.comment: An event attendance mode relation between an event and the enumeration indicating whether it occurs online, offline, or a mix. Examples: "Event 'Conference' eventAttendanceMode 'OnlineEventAttendanceMode'", "Event 'Workshop' eventAttendanceMode 'OfflineEventAttendanceMode'", "Event 'Hybrid Meeting' eventAttendanceMode 'MixedEventAttendanceMode'".

candidates.label: subEvent

candidates.label: legislationRepeals

candidates.label: sponsor

candidates.label: legislationApplies

candidates.label: publishedBy

candidates.label: legislationCommences

candidates.label: legislationCountersignedBy

candidates.label: legislationCorrects

candidates.label: legislationChanges
